title: T1584.004 — Compromise Infrastructure - Server
subtitle: Watch an attacker hijack a web server through an old CMS plugin, stage phishing and malware on it, abuse a target employee, and see what the SOC notices at the same time.
aria: Animated diagram: an attacker compromises a web server through a plugin vulnerability, stages phishing and malware on it, phishes a target employee, and a SOC detects the web shell, blocks the activity, and cleans the server. A written step-by-step version follows below.
